• Warning — To customers: Read this information before use.
• This product is for ages 15 and over. Do not give it to children younger than the recommended age.
• Keep batteries (sold separately), battery covers and screws away from children to prevent accidental swallowing.
• This product has pointed and sharp parts; handle and store it carefully to avoid unexpected injuries.
• Do not use this product near the ear. Accidental use near the ear can damage hearing.
• This product contains electronic components. If you use a pacemaker, keep this product away from your body.
• Do not stare at flashing LED lights. Prolonged viewing may cause nausea or other health effects.
• The included beast batteries are for use with the toy only. Do not use them for other purposes because they may cause accidents.
• Incorrect battery use can cause heat generation, explosion or leakage. Follow the precautions below.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert batteries with the correct polarity (+/−).
• Always turn the switch off and remove the batteries after playing. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If battery fluid gets into the eyes, wash immediately with plenty of water and consult a doctor. If fluid contacts skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing of the product or batteries, follow your local waste disposal regulations.
